features: Unified Liquid Glass Dropdown Sheets: Migrated all dropdown pickers, action sheets, region selection, and confirmation modals to a unified ZenDropdown liquid glass component
Instant First-Click Search Results: Submitting a search now immediately loads and renders results on the very first tap with zero delays or suggestion traps

Smart Relevance & Popularity Search Ranking: Prioritizes famous, most-streamed tracks, official audio studio recordings, and exact keyword matches while preventing random artist profiles from dominating search results
Automatic Update Notification: Older version users are now automatically notified on app startup with a full interactive changelog and 1-tap in-app APK installer
fixes: Fixed search results requiring a second click to display
Fixed search queries mistakenly defaulting to random artist profiles over songs
Fixed fragmented sheets by replacing legacy Cupertino and custom dialogs with unified ZenDropdown
Fixed all static analysis warnings across search, settings, and profile modules
improvements: Optimized search ranker server prior weighting and duration scoring
Refined SF Pro typography hierarchy across all lyrics and sheet titles
Ultra-compact release APK with instant install and zero ad overhead
releaseNotes:
• Unified liquid glass sheets across Settings, Profile, and Apple Music options
• Instant first-click search results with no suggestions trap
• Weighted YouTube Music search ranking prioritizing popular tracks over random artists
• Automatic background update notifications with changelog
message: Update to v1.1.16 for unified liquid glass sheets, instant search results, and enhanced song ranking
